lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to use operator blocks (+ − × ÷ and join) to calculate, and check a typed answer against the right result.
They go inside other blocks, like a calculator inside your code.
Compare what the player typed with the right answer using =.
If they match, the answer is correct.
“join” glues words and numbers together so a sprite can say a whole sentence, like “Total: 7”.
Store a number in a variable, then do maths with it later.
That is how calculators and games keep track of things.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
